feed.title: Enacted — Maryland Water Quality & Resources Topic Feed
feed.subtitle: Records what changed in enacted land-use law and public water quality. Does not advise, approve, determine, or certify anything.

entry.title: Broad Creek · Lead and Copper Rule Monitoring and Reporting
entry.summary: As reported by Anne Arundel County Department of Public Works for Broad Creek: Assessed a monitoring and reporting violation for October 1 through 14, 2025. Governing requirement: 30 samples (Maryland Department of the Environment / EPA Lead and Copper Rule; compliance date: October 1 through 14, 2025; basis: Minimum 30 lead and copper samples collected and analyzed by reporting deadline; status: Violation assessed for October 1 through 14, 2025).

entry.title: Crownsville · Lead
entry.summary: As reported by Anne Arundel County Department of Public Works for Crownsville: <2.0 µg/L. Governing requirement: 15 µg/L (EPA Lead and Copper Rule (Action Level); compliance date: In force; basis: 90th percentile of customer tap samples).

entry.title: Distribution System Customer Taps · Lead
entry.summary: As reported by Washington Suburban Sanitary Commission (WSSC Water) for Distribution System Customer Taps: <2.0 µg/L. Governing requirement: 15 µg/L (EPA Lead and Copper Rule (Action Level); compliance date: In force (Action level lowers to 10 µg/L beginning November 1, 2027); basis: 90th percentile of customer tap samples).

entry.title: Patuxent Water Filtration Plant Tap · Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA)
